verdict.rationale: Jules' docs state outright that the developer is notified both when a task completes and when it needs input, matching both halves of the story. A community report of Jules prompting the user to review work and give feedback when it could not finish loosely supports the needs-input case. missing for 10: documentation of notification channels (email, push, browser) and configuration options, independent hands-on corroboration of completion notifications.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get notified when an agent completes a task or needs my input

citations.quote: You’ll be notified when the task completes or needs your input.
Please review the work done so far and provide feedback for Jules to continue.
